games.name: (ANCIENT SHRINE) Crawl [ALPHA]
games.desc:
Thank you all for supporting the game. It has meant the world to me how much support my small project has gotten. 

Feel free to experience crawl before I fixed it.

You are a traveler from a distant warrior land, destined to become the king of your realm.  Abandoned by your ambition to become mightier than God, you ended up here, where you would sooner perish, but by some miracle, a stroke of luck, you have been given a second chance to become stronger.  Battle through vast dungeons to obtain powerful gear and spells to claim your promised inheritance.  Fight alone or with your friends and companions to become your true potential. Walk away from this as you emerge into a being greater than God, but before you walk, you must crawl.

games.name: [Mobile Support] Tower Galactica
games.desc:
Tower Galactica has been discontinued on Roblox. The game's difficulty may vary a lot as a result of this, and future Roblox updates may cause bugs. Maybe one day it may receive a successor on a different platform, but until then, this is the end.

It isn't very easy leading an entire planet, especially one with constant outside threats. In this game, you are the monarch of a planet named Orbis. Fortunately, you have your associate, Plavo, to help you out with that. Unfortunately, tragedy is set to strike at any moment in this chaotic and unforgiving universe.

Tower Galactica is a tower defense game centered around a story-mode, having lots of stages and galaxies, each with their own separate enemies and maps.
